title: Compliance Request Command Center: DPA packaging & residency verification
creator: Sofia Martinez
description:
Goal: Build a centralized "Compliance Request Command Center" in the Console that lets Redwood support and customer security teams intake, triage, and fulfill customer compliance requests (DPAs, SOC/ISO evidence, residency & retention attestations) with minimal manual effort. The Command Center should produce verifiable, auditable bundles and one-click exports (PDF/zip to Drive/S3) and provide runbooks and owner assignment for items requiring human review.

Scope (MVP):
- Customer-facing intake form and internal intake queue (annotations, owner assignment, SLA timer).
- DPA package generator: assemble signed DPA template + current diagrams (network/residency) + configured retention settings + key inventory and KMS metadata.
- Residency verification checklist: automatically evaluate active deployments, model routing, and storage regions for a given customer to produce a region-locking attestation.
- Evidence export: assemble logs, audit trails, config snapshots, and policy docs into a ZIP with an integrity manifest and cryptographic hash.

Phase 2 (post-MVP):
- Automated questionnaire responder: map common questionnaire items to system sources (e.g., SSO logs, encryption-at-rest), mark unanswered items for manual action.
- Scheduled evidence refresh and retention enforcement workflows.
- Integration with DocuSign and customer GDrive/S3 for automated delivery.

Constraints & Non-goals:
- We will not replace legal review for negotiated DPAs — Command Center produces standard DPA templates and supporting artifacts for legal to attach signatures.
- This does not include building a full-blown compliance management CRM; focus is on request fulfillment and evidence packaging.

Risks:
- Data-mining for evidence must respect RBAC and residency constraints; implement safeguards to avoid cross-region data pulls.
- Incorrect attestation could be high impact; require multi-person approval for final exports on high-risk customers.

Implementation notes:
- Backend: new compliance-api service that aggregates sources (audit logs, runtime metadata, KMS inventory, retention configuration service).
- UI: command-center console page with queue, SLA columns, templated generators, and export buttons. Use existing Console component library.
- Security: export manifests signed with an internal HSM key and logged in the audit pipeline.

Stakeholders: Security & Compliance (review), Legal (DPA templates), Support/Success (operational workflows), Engineering (runtime and logs), Product (prioritization).
comments: 2025-11-19 - Kickoff: Reviewed scope with Security and Legal. Legal provided two baseline DPA templates (standard + strict). Action: PM to collect required diagram generation inputs from Infra.
2025-12-05 - Engineering spike: ENG-9184 ran a data-sampling spike to verify audit log retention windows. Spike showed we can generate a 90-day log slice within 45s for 99% of customers.
2026-01-13 - Design review: Aisha Patel shared wireframes for the queue view and export flow; requested inline SLA timers and 'evidence completeness' badges for each request.
2026-02-02 - Security review: initial checklist approved; Security requested explicit RBAC gating for exports and mandatory second approver for 'high' customer impact exports.
2026-03-03 - Implementation update: Backend schema for manifest v1 landed (PR: github.com/redwood/infra/pull/1823). Next: implement region-scanner API and hook into Console exports.
2026-03-09 - PM note: Prepare runbook templates and success metrics for pilot with three Priority accounts. Coordinate with Solutions Engineering for early access.
acceptance_criteria: Intake form and internal queue are functional and visible to Support and Security teams.
DPA package generator produces a ZIP containing: selected DPA template, network/residency diagram PDF, retention configuration snapshot, and KMS key metadata with manifest and hash.
Residency verification report accurately lists active compute/storage regions and flags mismatches with customer residency requirements.
Exported bundles are cryptographically signed and recorded in the audit log; RBAC prevents unauthorized exports.
Pilot with 3 customers completed and feedback documented in Confluence (link below).
success_metrics: Reduce mean time to first deliverable for compliance requests from 6 days to <24 hours for standard cases.
Decrease manual evidence assembly effort by 70% for Support and Security teams.
Fewer than 2 manual escalations per month during pilot for residency-related attestations.
90% accuracy in automated questionnaire mapping for common security questionnaires during Phase 2 pilot.
